sections.name: goal
sections.value: Ship seat bookmarks: save, list and delete, durable across a daemon restart, with a list that launches nothing.

value.title: Durable bookmark store with save and delete
value.done_when: A seat saves a bookmark, the daemon restarts and the bookmark is still there; deleting it by name removes it and a second delete reports no such bookmark.

value.title: List a seat's own bookmarks without launching
value.done_when: Two seats each see only their own bookmarks, and ten lists in a row leave the daemon's spawn counter unchanged.
